verdict_rationale: Phase 4F.4.1 execution engine successfully implemented all 8 safety fixes, with 243 passing tests and zero model mutations. However, code-level inspection and offline tests revealed two high-severity architectural gaps that must be corrected before live execution: (1) lack of OS-level file locking during authorization consumption, permitting concurrent double-consumption races; and (2) absence of pre-execution on-disk manifest file hashing, where the runner validates authorization against a hardcoded Python constant rather than reading and hashing the manifest file on disk.

findings.title: Concurrent Authorization Consumption Race Condition
findings.impact: Multiple concurrent worker processes pointing to the same authorization file can read consumed=False simultaneously before any process replaces the file, permitting multiple unauthorized campaigns from a single authorization record.
findings.recommended_correction: Implement mandatory advisory file locking (fcntl.flock with LOCK_EX) on the authorization file descriptor across the read, check, and atomic write operations in CampaignAuthorizationRecord.consume().

findings.title: Missing Pre-Execution On-Disk Manifest File Hashing
findings.impact: The runner verifies authorization against a static Python constant EXPECTED_MANIFEST_SHA256 rather than reading and hashing the actual artifacts/manifests/phase_4f4_execution_manifest.json file on disk. Any post-authorization tampering or accidental edits to the manifest file on disk go undetected at execution time.
findings.recommended_correction: Add manifest_path parameter to Phase4F4Runner.execute_campaign() defaulting to artifacts/manifests/phase_4f4_execution_manifest.json. Read its raw bytes immediately before preflight, compute its SHA256, and verify that disk_manifest_sha256 == auth_record.manifest_sha256 == EXPECTED_MANIFEST_SHA256.

findings.title: Container Launch Command Uses Mutable Tag Instead of Immutable Digest Reference
findings.reproduction_test: Code inspection of docker run invocation in TrialIsolationManager.initialize_fresh_container
findings.impact: TrialIsolationManager launches containers with the mutable tag postgres:16-alpine rather than the immutable digest postgres@sha256:cf78e76683b9ca8c5733cbbdce6c9262b45b6767934dd0a95e671f9a0fc20685. While verify_container_effective_resources checks RepoDigests before warm-up, the container instantiation itself relies on the local tag table.
findings.recommended_correction: Pass the full immutable reference postgres@sha256:... directly to docker run in initialize_fresh_container.

findings.title: Static Default Artifacts Root Directory Overwrites Evidence on Campaign Re-runs
findings.reproduction_test: Code inspection of artifacts_root default in execute_campaign
findings.impact: If an interrupted campaign is re-run with a fresh authorization without explicitly specifying artifacts_root, it writes to artifacts/phase_4f4_empirical/trials/, overwriting previous trial artifact folders in-place.
findings.recommended_correction: Namespace default artifacts root with the execution ID (e.g. artifacts/phase_4f4_empirical/{execution_id}) or create a dedicated archive on new campaign startup.

findings.title: Throttling Telemetry Aggregation Defaults None to 0.0 Seconds
findings.reproduction_test: Code inspection of condition_summaries in execute_campaign
findings.impact: In condition summaries, throt_sec_vals = [t['cgroup_cpu']['throttled_sec'] or 0.0 for t in trials] substitutes 0.0 for missing cgroup throttling telemetry.
findings.recommended_correction: Filter out None values or record explicit availability status in condition summary consistent with FIX 03.
